_comment: Hand-curated retrieval golden set. Each query is grounded in a specific passage of one data/*.txt file, verified by reading the source document (not generated blind). expected_source is the filename retrieval should surface at or near rank 1. This is a RETRIEVAL evaluation set (does the right document come back) — it does not judge answer quality/faithfulness, which would require an LLM judge and is out of scope for this air-gapped harness. See eval/README.md.

What document must departments submit alongside their budget for an AI or automation initiative?
Above what dollar amount does an AI investment require Technology Investment Committee review?
What revenue decline range is used to model the downside budget scenario?
Who gives final approval to the proposed annual budget?
Which internal control framework does the organization's control environment align with?
What are the three severity tiers used to classify a control deficiency?
